name: rawtrace-mcp
description: Passive Chromium CDP capture: baselines, incremental changes, and queryable browser history.

interface.shortDescription: Record incremental DOM and network history
interface.longDescription: Attach to an existing authorized Chromium CDP browser. Record selected pages continuously, then query events and reconstruct recorded state. Browser actions stay with your existing controller.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rawtrace-debug-browser to diagnose this flaky browser behavior with RawTrace.
